# One-shot: drop stale Douyin prefab overrides from the playable scene.
from pathlib import Path

scene = Path(r"Assets/Scenes/Mechanics_Code.unity")
text = scene.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
lines = text.splitlines(keepends=True)
out = []
i = 0
removed = 0
drop_keys = {"ParaLuaBindingData", "managedReferences", "NetGUID"}
while i < len(lines):
    line = lines[i]
    if line.startswith("    - target:"):
        block = [line]
        i += 1
        while i < len(lines) and lines[i].startswith("      "):
            block.append(lines[i])
            i += 1
        prop = ""
        for entry in block:
            if "propertyPath:" in entry:
                prop = entry.split("propertyPath:", 1)[1].strip()
                break
        key = prop.split(".", 1)[0].split("[", 1)[0]
        if key in drop_keys:
            removed += 1
            continue
        out.extend(block)
    else:
        out.append(line)
        i += 1

new_text = "".join(out)
if not new_text.startswith("%YAML 1.1\n"):
    raise SystemExit("scene header changed")
if "ParaLuaBindingData" in new_text or "NetGUID" in new_text or "com.douyin" in new_text:
    raise SystemExit("douyin tokens remain")
if "guid: 32e47967e58b0e846b4d43f3bce936fc" not in Path(r"Assets/Prefabs/DialogueManager.prefab").read_text(encoding="utf-8"):
    raise SystemExit("dialogue manager prefab missing")
scene.write_text(new_text, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
print("removed_overrides", removed)
print("lines", new_text.count("\n"))

def yaml_str(value):
    if value is None:
        value = ""
    chars = []
    for ch in value:
        code = ord(ch)
        if ch == "\\":
            chars.append("\\\\")
        elif ch == '"':
            chars.append('\\"')
        elif code < 32 or code > 126:
            chars.append("\\u%04x" % code)
        else:
            chars.append(ch)
    return '"' + "".join(chars) + '"'


def decode_name(raw):
    raw = raw.strip()
    if raw.startswith('"') and raw.endswith('"'):
        raw = raw[1:-1]
    return raw.encode("utf-8").decode("unicode_escape")


def mono_block(file_id, go_id, script_guid, fields):
    lines = [
        "--- !u!114 &%d" % file_id,
        "MonoBehaviour:",
        "  m_ObjectHideFlags: 0",
        "  m_CorrespondingSourceObject: {fileID: 0}",
        "  m_PrefabInstance: {fileID: 0}",
        "  m_PrefabAsset: {fileID: 0}",
        "  m_GameObject: {fileID: %d}" % go_id,
        "  m_Enabled: 1",
        "  m_EditorHideFlags: 0",
        "  m_Script: {fileID: 11500000, guid: %s, type: 3}" % script_guid,
        "  m_Name: ",
        "  m_EditorClassIdentifier: ",
    ]
    for key, value in fields:
        if isinstance(value, bool):
            lines.append("  %s: %d" % (key, 1 if value else 0))
        elif isinstance(value, int) and not isinstance(value, bool):
            lines.append("  %s: %d" % (key, value))
        elif isinstance(value, float):
            lines.append("  %s: %s" % (key, value))
        elif isinstance(value, str) and value.startswith("{fileID:"):
            lines.append("  %s: %s" % (key, value))
        else:
            lines.append("  %s: %s" % (key, yaml_str("" if value is None else str(value))))
    return "\n".join(lines)

def strip_components(doc, removed_ids):
    lines = doc.split("\n")
    out = []
    for line in lines:
        match = re.match(r"  - component: \{fileID: (\d+)\}", line)
        if match and int(match.group(1)) in removed_ids:
            continue
        out.append(line)
    return "\n".join(out)
